_meta.purpose: A SHARED PUBLIC CATALOGUE of clinically significant loci (rsID → a GRCh38 position + alleles). It contains nobody's genotypes and is NOT derived from anybody's genome — it is a standard list of interest (CPIC/pharmacogenetics genes + a few longevity markers), the same for every user. Everyone applies THE SAME catalogue to THEIR OWN full VCF. Freely distributed with the code/skill.
_meta.usage: The catalogue only says «what this position means». The genotypes themselves are always taken from the user's personal VCF (genome/*.vcf.gz), which stays on their machine.
_meta.extensible: The list is extended by adding new rsID→coordinate entries (verify them against Ensembl GRCh38). The application works with the full VCF; the catalogue defines which loci it is able to interpret.
_meta.source: The coordinates were verified against primary sources (assembly GRCh38), not from memory: the original 17 loci — Ensembl REST; the loci added on 2026-08-13 — from the NCBI ClinVar VCF (fileDate 2026-07-20, reference GRCh38), the fields RS/GENEINFO/CLNSIG. ref = the reference allele, alt = the alternative one (the forward strand of the genome). The second build (`pos_grch37`) was added on 2026-08-19 from NCBI dbSNP and the Ensembl GRCh37 REST endpoint, cross-checked against real GRCh37 corpus files where those carried the locus — see `assembly_secondary_note`. rs4680 (COMT Val158Met) was added on 2026-09-12 from the Ensembl REST endpoints of both builds and from NCBI dbSNP esummary (`chrpos`, `chrpos_prev_assm`); the two agreed on both numbers, and the dbSNP SPDI `NC_000022.11:19963747:G:A` confirms the reference base. The loci added on 2026-09-13 (the radar-segment panels, task 179) were verified against Ensembl REST GRCh38 and NCBI dbSNP esummary (chrpos), which agreed on every position; `ref` is the first allele of Ensembl's allele string; `alt` is the allele the note is about, chosen on the plus strand with the gene's strand in mind. Where the two sources disagreed on GRCh37, `pos_grch37` is null and the note says so. The 28 positions added on 2026-09-17 (the three new systems of task 200 and the amino acid panel) carry the coordinate of their HGVS, which was itself verified against Ensembl REST GRCh38 and, for the amino acid positions, against the GWAS Catalog; `ref` is the reference base of that HGVS and `alt` its alternative on the plus strand, so a row whose risk allele is written on the minus strand says so in its note. On 2026-09-17 the two sources agreed on the GRCh37 position of rs111033565 (PRSS1) and rs641738 (MBOAT7/TMC4), which had been held without a second coordinate since they disagreed; both numbers are now carried, written by the same check that compares them. Nine more amino acid positions on 2026-09-18 (ABCG2, SLC16A9, PPM1K rs7678928, GLS2, NAT8, GCKR, GNMT, PSPH region, PRODH): coordinates from Ensembl REST GRCh38 fetched for each rsID, alleles from the GWAS Catalog records; ABCG2 and GCKR are spelled on the plus strand and their notes say what the literature's spelling is.
_meta.chrom_note: chrom without a prefix; when the VCF is queried the 'chr' prefix is determined from the VCF contigs.
_meta.regions_note: `regions` holds whole-gene windows for the alignment target. A point locus is padded from `loci` and needs nothing here; a gene lands here only when A POINT IS NOT ENOUGH — CYP2D6 is called from structural variation (Cyrius/PyPGx over the BAM), so the gene has to be in the target entire. Two entries would already be one too many: every window is a coordinate, and coordinates written twice drift. `src/ingest/fastq_to_vcf.sh` generates its BED from `loci` plus this section — it carries no table of its own.

assembly_secondary_note.en: `pos` is GRCh38 and always was. `pos_grch37` is the same locus's position in GRCh37, and all 54 loci now carry one. Three independent sources were used: real GRCh37 files that carry rsIDs (public Genes for Good exports in the PGP corpus, accepted only where REF/ALT also matched this catalogue — 30 of 30 did); NCBI dbSNP esummary, field `chrpos_prev_assm`; and the Ensembl GRCh37 REST endpoint. A value was written ONLY where every source that answered gave the same number: 30 loci carry corpus+NCBI+Ensembl and 24 carry NCBI+Ensembl, none carries fewer than two, and no source disagreed with another anywhere in the table. `src/tools/fill_grch37.py` is the script that asked; it names disagreements instead of writing them, and it must be run from a machine with a network. It is NEVER computed from `pos`: the offset between builds is not constant even inside one chromosome (405 kb of spread on chr1 across the measured pairs), so arithmetic would give a plausible position pointing at the wrong base.
assembly_secondary_note.ru: `pos` — это GRCh38, и так было всегда. `pos_grch37` — позиция того же локуса в GRCh37, и теперь она есть у всех 54 локусов. Использованы три независимых источника: настоящие файлы GRCh37 с rsID (публичные выгрузки Genes for Good в корпусе PGP, принятые только там, где REF/ALT совпали с этим каталогом — совпали 30 из 30); NCBI dbSNP esummary, поле `chrpos_prev_assm`; и Ensembl GRCh37 REST. Значение записано ТОЛЬКО там, где все ответившие источники дали одно и то же число: у 30 локусов это корпус+NCBI+Ensembl, у 24 — NCBI+Ensembl, меньше двух нет ни у одного, и нигде источники не разошлись. Спрашивает скрипт `src/tools/fill_grch37.py`: расхождения он называет, а не записывает, и запускать его нужно с машины с сетью. Из `pos` координата НИКОГДА не вычисляется: смещение между сборками непостоянно даже внутри одной хромосомы (разброс 405 тыс. оснований на chr1 по измеренным парам), и арифметика дала бы правдоподобную позицию, указывающую не на то основание.

assembly_secondary_open.en: The position question is closed — every locus answers in both builds. Two things are not. (1) Allele orientation: rs6025, rs1065852 and rs762551 appear in a corpus GRCh37 file with REF/ALT the reverse of this catalogue's (file T>C vs catalogue C>T; G>A vs A>G; C>A vs A>C). Their GRCh37 positions here come from NCBI and Ensembl, not from that file, so the coordinates are unaffected; what is unresolved is which strand that exporter reports on, and it is left open rather than settled from one caller's output. (2) The same run also compared every GRCh38 position in this catalogue against dbSNP. It reported to the console and the console was not kept, so that comparison is not on record here — the script now writes a report file beside its output, and the next run will leave one.
assembly_secondary_open.ru: Вопрос о позициях закрыт — каждый локус отвечает в обеих сборках. Незакрытых два. (1) Ориентация аллелей: rs6025, rs1065852 и rs762551 встречаются в файле GRCh37 из корпуса с REF/ALT, обратными нашим (в файле T>C против C>T в каталоге; G>A против A>G; C>A против A>C). Координаты GRCh37 у них взяты из NCBI и Ensembl, а не из этого файла, так что на позиции это не влияет; неразрешено то, с какой цепи отчитывается этот экспортёр, и вопрос оставлен открытым, а не решён по выводу одного вызывателя. (2) Тот же прогон сверил и все координаты GRCh38 этого каталога с dbSNP. Он отчитался в консоль, консоль не сохранена — значит, этой сверки здесь нет на бумаге. Теперь скрипт пишет отчёт рядом с выходным файлом, и следующий прогон его оставит.
